phase_name: Secure submission, storage and immutable content versions
changes: Guided resumable submission drafts with publication context, update, resume and cancellation
Creator and Agency role enforcement for submission and revision actions
PDF, DOCX, TXT, PNG and JPG/JPEG server-side signature, container, MIME and resource-limit validation
Fail-closed ClamAV scanning before document extraction and durable storage
SHA-256 duplicate checks and idempotent staged upload retries
Immutable local filesystem writes and conditional S3-compatible object creation
Content-version scan, retention and parent-version metadata
Transactional ReviewRun context and durable ReviewJob outbox row for each successful content version
Authenticated hash-verified download gate for CLEAN originals
Phase 05 integration and unit regressions for supported files, role boundaries, scanner failures, retries and storage immutability

skip_reasons: PostgreSQL RLS enforcement (requires PostgreSQL CI service)
Concurrent version/publication locking (requires PostgreSQL CI service)
verification.typescript_syntax_parse: passed for 17 frontend .ts/.tsx files with zero syntax diagnostics
verification.frontend_lint_typecheck_build: not verified; local node_modules incomplete and missing type definitions
verification.live_postgresql: not run locally; PostgreSQL CI job configured
verification.live_clamav: not run locally; integration tests inject scanner states and protocol tests are offline
verification.live_s3_or_minio: not run locally; S3 conditional writes covered by fake-client tests

limitations: Infected upload bytes are rejected before object-store persistence; no separate malware-binary quarantine bucket is implemented
ReviewJob is transactionally recorded but review execution remains inline; worker leases/checkpoints/replay belong to Phase 11
Retention expiry is recorded but no automatic purge or storage-orphan reconciliation job is implemented
PostgreSQL RLS and concurrent version allocation require live PostgreSQL CI evidence
Live ClamAV daemon/signature readiness and full frontend lint/typecheck/build remain externally unverified
Browser drag/drop/progress/reload/abort interactions require browser E2E verification
Scanned-PDF OCR and embedded PDF/DOCX visual-region extraction are Phase 06 work
